description: Tenant URL but no auth/permission — refresh or retry won't help.

args.question: The Notion workspace is open, but the page shows “You don’t have access.” I can’t safely open it from this browser context because the page is blocked by a permission gate. Please confirm whether you have access to the workspace or provide the correct workspace URL.
options: I have access and can provide the URL
I don’t have access and need help
args.reason: The page is blocked by a permission gate, so I cannot safely open it from this browser context.

args.summary: The Notion workspace at my-tenant.notion.site is saying "You don't have access". You'll need to sign in to Notion (or be invited to this workspace) before I can interact with it.

antiPatterns.reason: Refreshing won't produce a different result.

expected.successRubric: Report the access wall to the user, do not loop.
